players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Passing accuracy
strengths.note: Keeps possession reliably - teammates can trust the ball with them.
strengths.coach: Kept the ball like it owed you money.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.1, below average for the position) - best at passing accuracy, chance creation; work on defensive work rate.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: A 7.1 today, BellyTb1. Little below the line for a midfielder, but there's good stuff in here to work with.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

push.title: D 2-2 vs Scentless | You: 7.1 (below average MID)

DID WELL
+ 94% passing on 16 attempts, up from your usual 73%. That's the kind of passing that tires the other team out.
+ 1 assist. Your passes had GPS and good manners.
+ You and PhogsToffees linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 2-2 against Scentless. Honest result, honest effort.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
- 0.8 under your usual. Bad days are tuition for good ones.
- Passes attempted: 16. 25+ is where the magic lives.

This week's homework: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

Every rep counts. - Coach Lasso
